errors.text: The hypothesis substitutes a refractory bcc/fcc alloy for the target Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic FCC/B2 lamellar alloy.
It reconstructs a rolling-annealing-aging route rather than the target 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h HPHT treatment.
The proposed delta/gamma-double-prime precipitate evolution is composition-specific and is not supported for the target Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni alloy.
The predicted 2.0-2.2 GPa strength and 15% ductility do not match the target response of approximately 1150 MPa and 36% elongation.
The falsification experiment does not directly compare HPHT treatment against equal-temperature low-pressure thermal or HIP controls.
